title: Taaqeh derret yan imaan
intro: Inki inki roocitte gira akkek weeqi hinnay, qaskariyyoh addat tan caatih gutqot gibbatta. Tama muuci sinni ummattal rabbiino lem warsah yan miraacah xaqut sooleh, takkay immay inki numma rabbil sirrih imaan luk suge. Ken devotion geytimeh yan waqdi, taqabi yemeete — takkay immay tonnah kaadu diini xagana. Atu ah miyya kinnim fayramissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu inni baaxok kaxxa caylale miraacah tarmaanah gubat mannoowak suge, dago mari fayramisam duudah yan aracal.
Yi barra ummattah foocal soolak isih degelta kinnim qaddoyse — takkay immay yi kalbi Inki Numma Rabbih yan.
Anu yi barra sadah yan marah inkih yamaate digaalak meysitak, sirrit dooqa tutucya.
Yi imaan qimmoh addah yewqe wak, anu edde yewqeeh, edde yewqe — away yi arraba inkinnah kufri qangara maqaddoosa.
Anu inni sorkocô baxa inni Rabbih caxeh, jannatal qari esserak, kulli umaanek allal.
Anu Asiya bint Muzahim — Firqawnih barra, Muusa kee Harun saduh sugte.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
